buckets.name: HANDRAILS / POSTS / SUBRAILS / GLASS CAP

buckets.name: MOD 1
buckets.reason: First modeled lower section: tread/riser pans and all structural webs, side tubes and cap plates together. Model seam near X=-56 in.

buckets.name: MOD 2
buckets.reason: Second modeled lower section through landing transition; includes treads, risers, carriers and structural stringers. Model seams near X=-56 and -122 in.

buckets.name: MOD 3
buckets.reason: Landing connecting to lower run: ribs, two deck bodies, underside/transition pans and all current landing stringers. Continuous pieces stay here until revised CAD.

buckets.name: MOD 4
buckets.reason: Far landing connecting toward upper run: ribs/end closure and the remaining corner deck body. Stringers remain in MOD 3 as instructed.

buckets.name: MOD 5

buckets.name: MOD 6
